artBrief: **Japanese seasons.** One strong tree silhouette changes from blossoms to summer green, maple red, and snow across its canopy. A small book rests at the roots. No anniversary number in the art.

request.description: One original collectible achievement illustration for a language-learning app, native 128x128 pixel art, opaque square environmental scene. Crisp deliberate pixel clusters, clean readable silhouettes, restrained 32-color palette. A single strong focal subject should remain identifiable at 64x64. Fill the canvas but keep the main subject within an 8-pixel safe margin. No badge frame, lettering, numbers, readable text, logos or watermarks; no photorealism, blur or smooth vector art. Japanese seasons. One strong tree silhouette changes from blossoms to summer green, maple red, and snow across its canopy. A small book rests at the roots. No anniversary number in the art. One unmistakable tree with four distinct canopy regions: pale pink blossom, summer green, autumn red, snowy white. One continuous trunk and a closed book at the roots, no divided-panel borders.

style_image.usage_description: Copy only pixel cluster scale, crisp edge handling and shading discipline. Do not copy the reference scene, objects, layout or palette. Follow the new scene brief. Where a white fox is requested, preserve its pointed ears, muzzle and fluffy tail.
